name: Charleston
notes: Y Bot (Mixamo, from the three.js examples' Samba Dancing.fbx) dances a Charleston from the CMU motion capture library (subject 93, free for commercial use), turned to face the phone and retargeted by tools/make-dancer.mjs; the X Bot idle while the mystery box opens. The board rises on a stand beside him. Sources and the exact command: scenes/charleston/source/. The printed card (scenes/charleston/card.html) is a jazz-age Art Deco invitation with the Charleston step chart drawn on the round dance floor where he stands.
